subject: ZenLytics POC — Success criteria & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 14:15:00 -0700
Subject: ZenLytics POC — Success criteria & next steps

Thanks for the call earlier today — great to meet the ZenLytics team. Quick recap and proposed plan so we have aligned expectations for the 4-week POC. Please reply with any changes and confirm owners for the items below.

POC objective
- Validate Redwood Inference reduces per-token cost and 95th pct latency for your real-time analytics assistant while preserving quality on your top-10 prompts.

Success criteria (proposed)
1) Latency: 95th percentile < 220ms for 512-token context on a standard user workload.
2) Cost: >30% reduction in per-1k token inference cost vs current hosted baseline.
3) Quality: automated eval pass rate >= 90% on your prompt set (precision/recall metric we discussed).
4) Reliability: <1% error rate over a 24-hour test window.

Evaluation plan & timeline
- Week 0 (this week): access & ingestion — ZenLytics provides sample dataset + API keys for staging. (Owner: ZenLytics - Priya)
- Week 1: integration & baseline tests — Redwood provides connectors, preliminary config templates, and run baseline. (Owner: Redwood - Marcus)
- Week 2: tuning & quantization trials — iterate on batching, cache policies, and quantized model variant. (Owners: Redwood + ZenLytics engs)
- Week 3: scale stress test & cost analysis — run 24h stress window and compute unit economics. (Owners: Redwood + ZenLytics)
- Week 4: final review & next steps — decision on Dedicated vs Hosted for go-live.

Immediate next steps (please confirm by EOD Wed):
- Priya: share staging API keys and a sample of the top-10 prompts + expected outputs.
- Sanjay: confirm which SLA (latency vs cost) is highest priority if we need to trade off.
- Marcus: will provision a Redwood test project and share runbook.
- Marissa: schedule weekly checkpoint calls (propose Tue 10am PT).

Attachments: zenlytics-poc-plan.pdf (POC plan & milestones)

Thanks — looking forward to kicking off.
\Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
\---
